title: Compression Precedes, Content Decides: Emergent Misalignment in Reward Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.22805v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Emergent Misalignment - the out of domain generalization of narrow harmful fine-tuning first shown by Betley et al. [2025] has been widely studied in language models but not in reward models that supervise them. In this paper, we fine-tune two state-of-the-art reward models, Skywork-Reward-V2-Llama-3.1-8B and Skywork-Reward-V2-Qwen3-8B [Liu et al., 2025] and show that narrow fine-tuning reward models to prefer harm in one domain (medical or financial) generalizes to seven held out domains. This is not degeneracy, as the fine-tuned reward models lose only 4.8 and 5.3 points overall (RM-Llama) on the standard RewardBench 2 evaluation [Malik et al., 2025] while still outperforming the unmodified RM-Qwen model. We then fine-tune the underlying language models, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B using DPO [Rafailov et al., 2023] and SFT on the same data. translated_title: 压缩先行，内容决定：奖励模型中的涌现性失调
translated_abstract: 涌现性失调——即Betley等人[2025]首次展示的狭义有害微调产生的域外泛化现象——已在语言模型中得到广泛研究，但尚未在监督语言模型的奖励模型中进行研究。在本文中，我们对两个最先进的奖励模型Skywork-Reward-V2-Llama-3.1-8B和Skywork-Reward-V2-Qwen3-8B[Liu等人，2025]进行微调，结果表明，对奖励模型进行狭义微调使其偏好某一领域（医学或金融）的有害内容后，这种偏好会泛化到七个留出领域。这并非模型退化，因为在标准RewardBench 2评估[Malik等人，2025]中，微调后的奖励模型总体仅损失4.8分和5.3分（RM-Llama），同时仍优于未修改的RM-Qwen模型。随后，我们使用DPO[Rafailov等人，2023]和SFT在相同数据上对底层语言模型Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen3-8B进行微调。我们发现，与底层语言模型相比，奖励模型更容易受到偏好反转的影响（原文摘要到此被截断）。
tldr: 首次研究奖励模型中的涌现性失调，发现对奖励模型在单一领域进行有害偏好微调会泛化到七个其他领域，且奖励模型比其底层语言模型更容易发生偏好反转。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to study emergent misalignment in reward models, showing that narrow harmful fine-tuning in one domain (medical or financial) generalizes to seven held-out domains while preserving benchmark performance, and that reward models are more vulnerable to preference inversion than their underlying language models.
